title: Introducing a spooky twist on America’s favorite ranch
summary: Hidden Valley Ranch introduces Spooky Ranch, a limited-edition Halloween ranch with its classic flavor, a spooky color and glow-in-the-dark packaging.
body_markdown:
While the concept may feel playful, bringing Spooky Ranch to store shelves required extensive collaboration across the business. The R&D team worked to develop a product that delivered a Halloween-inspired appearance without compromising the taste and quality consumers expect from Hidden Valley Ranch. Brand partners helped shape the concept and consumer experience, while teams across sales, supply chain, finance, artwork, legal and regulatory helped bring the product to market in time for the Halloween season.


The cross-functional effort reflects Hidden Valley Ranch’s broader approach to innovation: creating products that tap into timely cultural moments while staying grounded in what consumers already love about the brand. It’s an approach that’s helping companies across the food industry generate excitement and incremental growth through limited-time offerings, which can deliver sales lifts of[20% to 30%](https://www.fead.ca/blog/master-urgency-limited-edition-products-cpg) during their run periods.
